verdict.rationale: The getting-started docs give an official container image and a docker run command (localai/localai:latest exposing port 8080), so the runtime clearly runs in a container. Environment-driven configuration such as PRELOAD_MODELS supports declarative, repeatable setup. Missing for 10: pinned/versioned image tags (the example uses :latest), GPU-specific container variants, compose/Kubernetes deployment docs, guidance on volume-mounting models for reproducibility, and independent hands-on corroboration.
